GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat last 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on ok but never threatened # not the worst
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 Lengths 800m 5th 5 Lengths home turn 6th Middle Of Track Straight no run on final 300m # one paced run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly throughout the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, gave ground turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back 6-7l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well # back/home ok

Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m & Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & worked home fairly without threatening in last 200m. # Last 150m OK.
Jumped Ok , Drifted Back in second half Two Wide 6 Lengths 600m, Ridden Along between runners soon after Straightening Up , Just one paced last 200m and only held ground # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m was awkwardly placed on the heels of another runner when attempting to shift out in an attempt to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6 lengths. hooked Wide turn 6 lengths. ran on strongly # went well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 700m lost its rightful running and was checked when another runner shifted in when insufficiently clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened in Straight # Every Chance
Jumped Ok sat 3l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, battled on well # even effort
Jumped Ok sat 3-4l off 4 Wide No Cover , under pressure turn and dropped out # 4 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was shifted behind runners from a wide barrier. Raced very wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, ran on well making good ground late # best work late
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn. checked by winner 150 metres. protested. # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed suitable to race. Prior to the declaration of correct weight Stewards considered a protest lodged by the rider of second place getter against first place getter alleging interference passing the 150m. Whilst it was established that runner had shifted in under riding carrying runner in at this stage causing interference, Stewards considering the beaten margin and how both horses finished, dismissed the protest and correct weight was declared.
